title: GitLab week 1 review - CI/CD and your first pipeline
description: Eight questions on what a pipeline is, where it lives, and what you saw in the job log.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between continuous delivery and continuous deployment?

options.text: Delivery runs tests; deployment does not
Delivery keeps every change deployable with a human deciding on production; deployment removes that last human step
Deployment is for staging, delivery is for production

questions.explanation: Continuous delivery stops at 'deployable'; continuous deployment ships every green pipeline on main automatically.

questions.prompt: Where does a GitLab pipeline definition live?

options.text: In Settings → CI/CD as form fields
In a .gitlab-ci.yml file at the root of the repository

questions.explanation: The pipeline is YAML in the repository, versioned and reviewed like code.

questions.prompt: Two jobs are in the same stage. How do they run?

options.text: One after the other, in file order
In parallel, if runners are available

questions.explanation: Jobs in one stage run together; the next stage waits for all of them.

questions.prompt: A job writes a file to /tmp. Can a job in the next stage read it?

options.text: Yes, if the file is under the project directory
No - every job starts from a clean clone; only artifacts are handed forward

questions.explanation: Nothing survives between jobs except artifacts (and cache, best effort).

questions.prompt: Which two stages always exist even when you declare your own stages: list?
questions.explanation: .pre and .post bracket every pipeline; declaring stages replaces the middle defaults.

questions.prompt: A job's script fails but its after_script succeeds. What is the job's status?

options.text: Failed - only script decides the status

questions.explanation: after_script runs in a separate shell and never changes the job status.

questions.prompt: You fix a syntax error in .gitlab-ci.yml and press Retry on the failed job. Why does it still fail?

options.text: Retry re-runs the same job with the same commit; a new pipeline is needed to read the new file
Retry only works on manual jobs

questions.explanation: Retry replays the job as it was; push the fix to get a new pipeline.

questions.prompt: On gitlab.com shared runners, what is image: in a job?

options.text: The Docker container the job's shell runs in

questions.explanation: With the docker executor, image: is the container your script runs in.
